study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Pinaya et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2019
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using deep autoencoders to identify abnormal brain structural patterns in neuropsychiatric disorders: A large-scale multi-sample study

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Deep Autoencoder with 3 hidden layers (100-75-100 neurons), using SELU activation and L2 regularization. It is a denoising autoencoder trained with a semi-supervised approach to predict age and sex alongside reconstruction.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We used an artificial neural network known as ' deep autoencoder ' to create a normative model ... The deep autoencoder was trained using all subjects from the HCP data set. In our model, we used a similar approach to a denoising autoencoder ... In this study, we used neuroimaging data from disease-free individuals to create a deep autoencoder for detecting and elucidating neuroanatomical deviations in individual patients.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness for 68 regions and volume of 36 neuroanatomical structures (total 104). The 36 structures include subcortical volumes (e.g., Thalamus, Caudate), ventricular/CSF volumes (e.g., Lateral Ventricle, CSF), and Corpus Callosum segments.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: This procedure allowed us to calculate the cortical thickness for each of the 68 cortical subregions (34 per hemisphere) and the volume of 36 neuroanatomical structures; therefore, the total number of subregions/structures being investigating was 104.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and Sex were incorporated into the model using a semi-supervised framework, where the model learns to predict them alongside reconstructing the input.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Similar to Cheung, Livezey, Bansal, and Olshausen (2014), we added information about our samples (in our case, age and sex values) in the structure of the model. ... we incorporated supervised learning within the model to enable learning of age and sex.
